fields.name: magic_signature
fields.evidence: ghidra/decompiled.c FUN_08010158 byte stores reproduce the exact ASCII sequence found at saves/cap-00-future-0.sav offset 0x0000.

fields.name: header_padding
fields.evidence: saves/hexdump_and_diffs.txt shows zero bytes at offset 0x000b-0x000f; no corresponding write instruction found in ghidra/decompiled.c.

fields.name: slot_checksum_byte
fields.evidence: Formula in ghidra/decompiled.c FUN_08010490; position/resting-value verified numerically against all 8 slots in saves/cap-00-future-0.sav, but the all-zero sample cannot disambiguate the exact coverage length N.

fields.name: slot_body_unmapped
fields.evidence: Only a blank/never-played save sample is available; a post-gameplay non-blank .sav is required to map any field inside the slot body.

fields.name: unused_sram_tail
fields.evidence: Directly observed byte range in saves/cap-00-future-0.sav; corroborated by absence of any matching address arithmetic in ghidra/decompiled.c.
